subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio transcription history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, provider-cost, and visibility limits must it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silently processing unmentioned speech changes privacy, cost, retention, and configuration semantics beyond a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention and cost bounds, schema/docs, and requireMention history tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for shared media policy
options.body: Keep this as product input but avoid a Discord-only knob until shared channel media-history retention semantics are designed.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech must not be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention and cost bounds, schema/docs, and requireMention history tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent PR history and comments show this handle landing and reviewing the closest Discord audio and preflight-history behavior.
